title: 2017-18 Pilot / 2017-19 Ridgeline 6-speed: flashing D, P0741, cracked torque converter lock-up piston (10 yr / 150k)
summary: Honda Service Bulletin 23-078: a crack in the torque converter lock-up piston bleeds off pressure, so the lock-up clutch slips, the D indicator flashes and P0741 sets. Honda extended torque converter coverage to 10 years / 150,000 miles.

specs.name: DTC
specs.value: P0741 Torque Converter Clutch Performance or Stuck OFF, with the D indicator flashing

specs.name: Warranty extension
specs.value: Torque converter, 10 years or 150,000 miles from original purchase

specs.name: ATF after converter replacement
specs.value: 2WD 4.5 L (4.8 qt); AWD 5.2 L (5.5 qt), Honda ATF DW-1

specs.name: Labor
specs.value: 7.2 hr 2WD, 7.6 hr AWD (includes DTC clear and alignment)

steps.text: Confirm P0741 is stored and check the VIN for eligibility.
Replace the torque converter per the service manual's transmission removal and installation.

Fill with ATF DW-1 (4.8 qt 2WD / 5.5 qt AWD) and check the level only with fluid at 176 °F (80 °C) or above. A cold reading shows low; filling to the top dot cold overfills it, which increases foaming and overheating.

sources.title: Service Bulletin 23-078 (version 6): Warranty Extension: 2017-19 Multi Model 6AT Torque Converter - DTC P0741 Stored
